name: cue-coverage-report
description: A real Ollama extraction and a recorded Ollama answer flow through the report, preserving every omitted cue sentence and score arithmetic.
given: A local Ollama model, the sample posting, and the recorded extraction answer
when: Extract and assess the posting, then render its report
then: Uncovered cue text and offsets match V13, the trace records V13, and the rendered count equals the JSON report count
